one_line_reason: Only human trial testing chaga is a 4-herb combination product (chaga ~20% of the blend) for an alcohol/hangover outcome, not chaga alone or a typical use case.

selected.population: healthy, nonsmoking young men (n=20), crossover design
selected.intervention: DTS20 herbal mixture: Viscum album 40%, Lycium chinense 30%, Inonotus obliquus (chaga) 20%, Acanthopanax senticosus 10%, taken before alcohol consumption
selected.dose_as_stated: not stated (one package of DTS20 mixture; composition given as % of blend only)
selected.primary_outcome: oxidative stress markers and plasma alcohol/acetaldehyde levels after alcohol consumption
selected.why_selected: only human RCT-type record in the shortlist that includes chaga as an ingredient.

blockers: Combination herbal product — chaga (Inonotus obliquus) is only about 20% of a 4-herb blend, so the observed effect cannot be attributed to chaga alone.
Outcome studied (post-alcohol oxidative stress/hangover) is not a mapped catalog use for chaga products, which are generally marketed for immune/antioxidant support.
